description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of reasons for incorrect answers on a reasoning task, categorized into several failure modes. The chart contains five slices, representing “Correct,” “Atomic Skill Fail,” “Reasoning Error,” “Careless Error,” and “Other.” The “Correct” slice is light blue and occupies 21.0% of the chart. “Atomic Skill Fail” is a darker blue, taking up approximately 12.0%, while “Reasoning Error” is a medium blue and represents 14.0%. “Careless Error” is a light gray and accounts for 10.0% of the chart, and “Other” is a dark gray, representing 8.0%. The largest slice, representing 68.0% of the chart, is not labeled but is a darker blue. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and a legend is present to identify each category. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
